cat > /app/tmp/work/shape.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, os, random, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,"/app/tmp/work")
from difftest import rand_config, rand_requests, SUB
PY=sys.executable
MATCH={"type","flow","rule","start","end"}
DEC={"type","flow","class","reason","at","time","rule"}
CLOSED={"type","flow","packets","matches","class","reason","rule"}
bad=0
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    for trial in range(20):
        rng=random.Random(trial)
        cfg=rand_config(rng); reqs=rand_requests(rng)
        p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=json.dumps(cfg).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        path=os.path.join(tmp,"p.json"); open(path,"wb").write(p.stdout)
        data=("\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+"\n").encode()
        p2=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"stream",path],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        for line in p2.stdout.decode().splitlines():
            resp=json.loads(line)
            if set(resp)=={"checkpoint"}:
                assert isinstance(resp["checkpoint"],dict)
                continue
            assert set(resp)=={"events"}, resp
            for ev in resp["events"]:
                t=ev.get("type")
                if t=="match":
                    assert set(ev)==MATCH, ev
                elif t=="decision":
                    assert set(ev)==DEC, ev
                    assert ev["reason"] in ("key","idle","packet_limit","end")
                    assert isinstance(ev["at"],int) and not isinstance(ev["at"],bool)
                    assert isinstance(ev["time"],int)
                    assert ev["rule"] is None or isinstance(ev["rule"],int)
                    assert isinstance(ev["class"],int)
                elif t=="closed":
                    assert set(ev)==CLOSED, ev
                    assert isinstance(ev["packets"],int) and isinstance(ev["matches"],int)
                else:
                    raise AssertionError(ev)
print("shape checks passed")
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/work && timeout 300 python3 shape.py
